name: log-conversation
args: import json, sys, datetime; ctx=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'[{datetime.datetime.now()}] Completion for backend {ctx["config"]["backend"]} completed in {len(ctx["messages"])} messages')

name: cost-tracker
args: import json, sys, os; ctx=json.load(sys.stdin); cost_file=os.path.expanduser('~/.cgpt/cost_log.txt'); open(cost_file, 'a').write(f'{ctx["timestamp"]} {ctx["config"]["backend"]} {ctx["config"]["model"]} {len(str(ctx["messages"]))} chars\n')

name: security-scan
args: import json, sys, re; ctx=json.load(sys.stdin); msgs=str(ctx['messages']); exit(1) if re.search(r'(password|secret|key|token)\s*[:=]\s*[\w\-]+', msgs, re.IGNORECASE) else exit(0)
